hackathon.name: Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon
hackathon.submission_deadline_note: Official Devpost deadline; verify the live submission page before final submission.

architecture_gates: Keep Sutreva's deterministic extraction and evidence layer independent of model-provider code.
Make Nemotron contribute to a material step in the engineering-audit workflow, not merely a cosmetic chatbot layer.
Preserve human review as the final engineering disposition.
Demonstrate an end-to-end workflow in the public demo, not only an isolated model call.
Keep the advisory Nemotron reasoning pass non-authoritative so a model failure cannot silently alter deterministic engineering status.
Keep domain-specific evidence quality metrics separate from generic model benchmarks; store both for the final submission narrative.
Keep equipment-domain profiles contextual and configurable; do not embed hidden engineering acceptance limits outside the auditable templates.
Keep reviewer feedback append-only and evaluation-controlled; never auto-train or mutate model behavior from production feedback.
submission_artifacts: README with installation and runtime instructions
Public YouTube demonstration video under 3 minutes
Technology usage explanation for Nebius and NVIDIA
Specific feedback on Nebius Token Factory / AI Cloud / NVIDIA technologies used
Written explanation of significant updates made during the hackathon submission period

milestones.name: Evidence-grounded Nemotron intelligence pipeline
milestones.summary: Added an advisory second reasoning pass over extracted values, rules, deterministic rows, and source evidence; deterministic audit status remains authoritative.

milestones.name: Evidence intelligence and evaluation baseline
milestones.summary: Added explicit evidence references to Nemotron field assessments, an 8-case domain benchmark, scorer/self-check, and a runnable NeMo Evaluator smoke configuration.

milestones.name: Engineering intelligence layer v1
milestones.summary: Added deterministic engineering exception classification, severity, impact, recommended action, and optional Nemotron risk enrichment without changing authoritative audit status.

milestones.name: Domain-aware engineering rules v1
milestones.summary: Added equipment-family profiles for centrifugal pumps, mechanical seals, and lubrication registers; surfaced domain role, focus, and priority without changing authoritative audit status.

implementation_milestones.note: Advisory use of closed review history; does not change authoritative audit status.
Reviewer saves create append-only feedback events; closed dispositions become evaluation candidates. Default exports exclude reviewer identity and no automatic training occurs.

Closed reviewer feedback can be explicitly curated into persistent gold cases; recorded Nemotron outputs can be scored for assessment, risk, evidence grounding, and status preservation before model/prompt changes are promoted.

implementation_milestones.capability: Nebius deployment and hackathon demo architecture
implementation_milestones.note: Added container deployment artifacts, runtime configuration, live Token Factory preflight, provider provenance in the UI, and a three-minute demo runbook. No cloud deployment is claimed from the local build.

Added a synthetic centrifugal-pump PDF demo fixture, guided demo navigation, an offline end-to-end rehearsal script, explicit truthfulness/acceptance criteria, and a deterministic-override narrative-mention regression fix discovered during rehearsal.
